image_mapping.use: Only literal folio, canvas_id and image_service_url in frozen source order; no semantic labels or supplied width/height.

groups.excluded_boundary_policy: Leave their images at current positions; no inference for missing or mixed textual metadata.

parsing: Paragraph loci P[0-9a-z]; lowercase literal EVA tokens; comma splits; uncertainty tokens discarded; drawing breaks split. Preserve locus order.
split: For each page, successive accepted paragraph loci alternate selection (ordinal 0,2,...) and check (ordinal 1,3,...). Do not pick split or seed based on scores.
idf: Document frequency by physical leaf on all corpus leaves except 75..84 and 103..116, pooling both sides. No target-group lines in vocabulary/IDF.
selection: Maximize mean TF-IDF cosine across boundaries from second-leaf verso of one bifolium to first-leaf recto of next; exhaust all permutations. Ties within 1e-12 choose lexicographically smallest pair sequence.
checking: Evaluate selected permutation using check-half page vectors; exact inclusive upper-tail rank against all fixed-orientation permutations, tolerance 1e-12. Also report full 19/15 consecutive-page means versus filtered original sequence and char-trigram sensitivity. Do not select a different order after checking.
gate_Q13: Descriptive support only if check-half exact p<=0.05 and full-sequence check score exceeds current. Not historical validation: pages/corpus already explored, split halves are dependent.
Q20_inference: Descriptive only; four blocks imply minimum exact tail 1/24 and mixed omitted boundary bifolia prevent whole-Q20 inference.
copy_policy: Produce a hypothetical reading copy regardless of numerical support; always label NOT_HISTORICALLY_VALIDATED. Replace only the 20 Q13 image positions and 16 Q20-core image positions. Keep every other image at its source position. No split/flip/crop of scans or invented missing leaves.
controls: Identical vectors give ties and p=1
